biotools.summary: Roshambo is an open-source package for molecular alignment and 3D similarity scoring optimized for large-scale virtual screening of small molecules. It leverages Gaussian volume overlaps and GPU acceleration for efficiency, and offers a convenient Python API and command line interface.
